model_confirmation: yes but feel free to add more as needed
question: Do two additional model families supply enough confident votes to resolve calls that five reviewers left uncertain?
pre_pilot_expectation: Some ambiguity may be caused by missing evidence; extra judges may leave calls unresolved. Measure resolution before committing the full pass.
technical_gate: Both models must return valid binary labels for every supplied ID. Failed responses never vote; preserve every request and response. No automated retry of refusals.
pilot_cost_gate: Project measured costs onto 732 packets per model with a 30 percent allowance; re-evaluate before full pass if above the 190 dollar estimate. Existing user authorization permits cap expansion as needed, but named models still await confirmation.
blinding: No held key opened. Judges receive only shuffled command evidence and normalized tool definitions; no previous votes or world labels.
refusal_handling: Refused requests are missing votes and are never retried; other independently approved judges may classify those rows under the unchanged rubric.
